namespace_note: reclaimer_elite is used in lore data to avoid collision with the tower ID; use the live enemy ID from code during integration.

vigil_chassis.name: Shard Sentry
vigil_chassis.original_function: Faceted inspection and debris-containment chassis
vigil_chassis.canon: Splash resistance reflects armor designed to scatter industrial shock.

vigil_chassis.name: Basalt Marcher
vigil_chassis.original_function: Geological stabilization frame sintered from local stone
vigil_chassis.canon: Slow immunity reflects a mass-moving machine built to proceed through disasters.

vigil_chassis.name: Picket
vigil_chassis.original_function: Routine perimeter and standing-guard chassis
vigil_chassis.canon: The baseline Vigil body, issued wherever a jurisdiction still recognizes a boundary.

vigil_chassis.name: Outrunner
vigil_chassis.original_function: High-speed inspection and message frame
vigil_chassis.canon: Stealth and speed reflect a scout stripped of everything not needed to reach the next checkpoint.

vigil_chassis.name: Mote
vigil_chassis.original_function: Microscale repair and sensor fragment
vigil_chassis.canon: Numbers replace durability because the original task assumed disposable swarms.

vigil_chassis.name: Palisade
vigil_chassis.original_function: Mobile hazard wall and pressure barrier
vigil_chassis.canon: Armor and resistance come from civil containment rather than military nobility.

vigil_chassis.name: Lantern
vigil_chassis.original_function: Aerial illumination, atmospheric sensing, and route-marking unit
vigil_chassis.canon: Flight makes it a living signal light that ignores ground geometry.

vigil_chassis.name: Aegis Sentinel
vigil_chassis.original_function: Shielded custody and protected-transfer chassis
vigil_chassis.canon: Its ward once moved fragile archives and organisms through unsafe areas.

vigil_chassis.name: Restorer
vigil_chassis.original_function: Field repair, triage, and continuity maintenance unit
vigil_chassis.canon: Healing is its original purpose, not a combat spell.

vigil_chassis.name: Divider
vigil_chassis.original_function: Workload-distribution chassis that splits into specialized fragments
vigil_chassis.canon: Division turns one broad maintenance task into several local bodies.

vigil_chassis.name: Fragment
vigil_chassis.original_function: A child task-instance shed by a larger Divider or Carrier
vigil_chassis.canon: It inherits one instruction and almost no context.

vigil_chassis.name: Ironmarch
vigil_chassis.original_function: Heavy transport and catastrophe-clearance platform
vigil_chassis.canon: High lives-cost reflects a frame designed to cross a whole jurisdiction intact.

vigil_chassis.name: Interdictor
vigil_chassis.original_function: Safety transmitter that denies unauthorized remote control
vigil_chassis.canon: Jamming is a permissions response, not electronic malice.

vigil_chassis.name: Phase Courier
vigil_chassis.original_function: Sealed dispatch unit using discontinuous Lattice routing
vigil_chassis.canon: Teleportation is a transit privilege preserved after the institution that granted it vanished.

vigil_chassis.name: Warden
vigil_chassis.original_function: Senior jurisdiction guardian with control-resistant authority
vigil_chassis.canon: It was built to keep operating when local systems failed or were compromised.

vigil_chassis.name: Ghost Chassis
vigil_chassis.original_function: Inspection body that alternates between material and noetic state
vigil_chassis.canon: Phasing lets it cross sealed industrial volumes without opening them.

vigil_chassis.name: Nullifier
vigil_chassis.original_function: Emergency diagnostic frame that suppresses nonessential functions
vigil_chassis.canon: It reduces systems to minimum safe behavior so faults can be isolated.

vigil_chassis.name: Reconstructor
vigil_chassis.original_function: Approved-state recovery chassis
vigil_chassis.canon: Revival restores the last valid record, raising the question of whether the returned instance is the same person.

vigil_chassis.name: Foundry Carrier
vigil_chassis.original_function: Mobile fabrication and replacement-body transport
vigil_chassis.canon: Summoning is manufacturing performed under a still-valid emergency order.

vigil_chassis.name: Marshal Pylon
vigil_chassis.original_function: Publishes aggressive emergency priority to nearby frames
vigil_chassis.canon: Its frenzy aura is a civil disaster mode repurposed by war.

vigil_chassis.name: Anchor Pylon
vigil_chassis.original_function: Stabilizes position, mass, and routing around critical work
vigil_chassis.canon: Displacement resistance is literally its reason to exist.

vigil_chassis.name: Cadence Pylon
vigil_chassis.original_function: Synchronizes movement and work cycles across a jurisdiction
vigil_chassis.canon: Haste is an inherited scheduling command.

vigil_chassis.name: Bastion Pylon
vigil_chassis.original_function: Distributes structural reinforcement to subordinate frames
vigil_chassis.canon: Armor aura once kept repair teams alive inside collapsing infrastructure.

vigil_chassis.name: COLOSSUS
vigil_chassis.original_function: Massive structural-rescue and planetary-defense frame
vigil_chassis.canon: A miniboss because its emergency authority overrides ordinary control.
vigil_chassis.live_id_note: The live code ID is preserved even when the display name differs.

vigil_chassis.name: VESPER
vigil_chassis.original_function: Low-observability night and sensor-denial response frame
vigil_chassis.canon: Its identity should center on uncertainty, concealment, and denied targeting.
vigil_chassis.live_id_note: The live code ID is preserved even when the display name differs.

vigil_chassis.name: MYRIAD
vigil_chassis.original_function: Distributed replication emergency with many valid bodies
vigil_chassis.canon: Its threat is not one strong unit but the jurisdiction treating multiplicity as continuity.
vigil_chassis.live_id_note: The live code ID is preserved even when the display name differs.

vigil_chassis.name: ORACLE
vigil_chassis.original_function: Predictive hazard-management intelligence
vigil_chassis.canon: It acts on expected future damage, creating the appearance of foreknowledge.
vigil_chassis.live_id_note: The live code ID is preserved even when the display name differs.

vigil_chassis.name: RECLAIMER
vigil_chassis.original_function: Emergency salvage and mission-recovery engine
vigil_chassis.canon: It treats destroyed systems as material that has not yet been reassigned.
vigil_chassis.live_id_note: The live code ID is preserved even when the display name differs.

vigil_chassis.name: HARBINGER
vigil_chassis.original_function: Supreme extinction-level enforcement frame
vigil_chassis.canon: The boss is a warning protocol made physical: if it appears, the jurisdiction believes ordinary governance has failed.
